messages:
jess_support: Customer on plan-enterprise reports repeated 502/500 and high tail latency on /v1/embeddings. They provided request_id req_0a1b2c3d4e and window around 2026-03-10T14:02:11Z. Can someone confirm server logs and retention? Need repro steps.

matt_eng_oncall: I'll run quick cross-index search. @logs-bot please query prod-logs-* and prod-archive-* for that request_id.

logs-bot: Search summary: hits in prod-logs-2026.03.10: 2; prod-archive-* : 0. Hot indices retention 31d, warm 90d. For older, retrieval job needed (~4h ETA).

olga_infra: Retention reminder: hot 31d, warm 90d (S3). For this req_id we're within 31d so logs should be hot. If missing, try trace.id or truncated request_id.

jess_support: Please paste the KQL you used and sanitized log lines for customer. Also need a curl repro they can run setting X-Request-Id to correlate.

logs-bot: KQL used:

request_id:"req_0a1b2c3d4e" OR trace.id:"req_0a1b2c3d4e"
index: prod-logs-*
| sort @timestamp desc

Sample sanitized lines:
[2026-03-10T14:02:10.987Z] request_id=req_0a1b2c3d4e route=/v1/embeddings upstream=embed-node-22 status=200 latency_ms=1200 kv_cache_hit=false kernel=fp16
[2026-03-10T14:02:11.234Z] request_id=req_0a1b2c3d4e route=/v1/embeddings upstream=embed-node-09 status=502 backend_error="grpc: upstream reset" latency_ms=3120

matt_eng_oncall: Looks like 200 then 502 for same request_id — maybe partial retry or fallback. Grab proxy logs for upstream_reset. Query:

message:("upstream reset" OR "connection reset" OR "upstream_closed") AND request_id:"req_0a1b2c3d4e"
index: prod-logs-*

logs-bot: proxy-nginx-12 logged upstream_reset to embed-node-09 at 2026-03-10T14:02:11.210Z.

sre_lee: Check embed-node-09 for GPU driver resets / OOM around 14:02.

olga_infra: Host events: embed-node-09 had GPU driver reset at 14:01:59 UTC, recovered. Will pull host syslogs, dmesg, and driver logs in debug bundle.

jess_support: Provide curl to reproduce against staging and instructions for debug bundle. Use X-Request-Id header set to req_0a1b2c3d4e.

matt_eng_oncall: Example curl (use staging token):

curl -v -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_TEST_TOKEN>" \
  -H "X-Request-Id: req_0a1b2c3d4e" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-small-1","input":"test latency repro"}'

Add --max-time 10 for timeout checks. If they reproduce, capture response headers and body and paste here.

jess_support: Debug bundle create steps for customer:
1) Run curl with X-Request-Id.
2) If 5xx, POST to support debug-bundles endpoint with request_id and reason. Response includes bundle_id.

curl -s -X POST "https://console.redwood.example/api/support/debug-bundles" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_SUPPORT_TOKEN>" \
  -d '{"request_id":"req_0a1b2c3d4e","reason":"customer-repro-502-embed"}'

Share bundle_id here.

olga_infra: When creating bundle include client logs and exact time window so we collect syslogs, driver logs, and network captures. If archive pull needed use infra retrieval template.

infra retrieval template:
Subject: Archive retrieval request — indices: prod-logs-YYYY.MM (date range) — req_id: <req>
Body:
 - Requestor: <support_jess>
 - Reason: Customer escalation + repro
 - Indices/time window: 2026-03-10T14:00:00Z -> 2026-03-10T14:05:00Z
 - Cost approval: yes

matt_eng_oncall: Note: request_id might be truncated in some logs; expand search with wildcard or check trace.id. Example:
(request_id:"req_0a1b2c3d4e" OR request_id:"req_0a1b2c3d4*" OR trace.id:"req_0a1b2c3d4e")

sre_lee: Can we enable debug sampling for /v1/embeddings for 30m to increase KV-cache logs? Minimal risk but more volume.

olga_infra: I can enable debug sampling for 30m. Say the word and I'll flip it.

jess_support: Enable it. I'll wait for customer's curl attempt and bundle_id before escalating.

-- end of thread --
